WITH vote_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    CASE 
      WHEN pav.points_max IS NOT NULL AND pav.points_max > 0 
      THEN pav.points_won / CAST(pav.points_max AS NUMERIC)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS ratio
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  INNER JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
),
player_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    death_country,
    player_id,
    AVG(ratio) AS player_avg
  FROM vote_ratios
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY death_country, player_id
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    death_country,
    AVG(player_avg) AS country_avg
  FROM player_averages
  GROUP BY death_country
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) AS mean_of_means
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT 
  ca.death_country AS country,
  ca.country_avg AS average,
  ca.country_avg / gm.mean_of_means AS scaled_average
FROM country_averages ca, global_mean gm
ORDER BY ca.death_country
